data.name: American BioCarbon
data.description: American BioCarbon produces biochar, renewable energy, and carbon removal credits at its facility in Louisiana, USA, and is currently constructing one of the largest industrial biochar plants in the country, set to go live in 2026 as a self-powered facility. The company uses its patented Biomass Separation Unit combined with a proprietary pyrolysis process to transform bagasse, a byproduct of sugar cane processing, into biochar. Its CORCs are certified via Puro.earth and its biochar earned OMRI listing for organic agriculture use in January 2025.
